native.rs485_profile: Selected electrical test reference versus independently qualified actual devices.
native.rs485_topology: Actual balanced bus with electrically short stubs, or independently qualified alternative.
native.rs485_direction: Half duplex uses one pair; full duplex two independently controlled pairs, not simultaneous competing drivers per pair.
native.rs485_load_model: Actual homogeneous identical UL contribution versus individually measured aggregate bus load.
native.rs485_cable_profile: Selected TI recommended120ohm UTP proposal versus actual independently selected cable.
native.rs485_termination: Actual two-end parallel or split termination, qualified unterminated/alternative implementation.
native.rs485_load_scope: Actual electrical fixture: open,54ohm with50pF waveform,60ohm with375ohm commonmode loading, or application.
native.rs485_activity: Actual scheduled frame, idle, open, short, or contention state. Failsafe idle is not a new valid message.
native.rs485_logic_mapping: Actual VA-VB device truth table; A/B letters alone do not prove logical polarity.
native.rs485_failsafe: Actual commissioned internal/external failsafe or no specified behavior.
native.rs485_ground_scheme: Actual return path/ground potential and optional isolation commissioning, never automatic protective-earth return.
native.rs485_wire_protocol: Actual codec and media scheduling separate from electrical RS485.
native.rs485_outcome: Actual complete decoded transaction and functional acceptance status.
native.rs485_bitrate_bps: Actual serialized rate under selected driver/receiver/cable; no normative minimum or default10Mbps.
native.rs485_device_max_bps: Actual driver maximum under commissioned electrical conditions.
native.rs485_peer_max_bps: Actual receiver maximum under same conditions.
native.rs485_nodes: Actual connected transceiver count;32UL is not automatically32devices.
native.rs485_drivers: Actual connected drivers per pair, many allowed but only one active.
native.rs485_active_drivers: Actual simultaneously enabled drivers per pair;0idle/1frame, never2without contention.
native.rs485_unit_load: Actual receiver/poweroff driver UL per node, not universal1/8UL.
native.rs485_receiver_load_ul: Actual aggregate receiver/poweroff driver bus load.
native.rs485_bias_load_ul: Actual externally applied failsafe loading, not universal20UL.
native.rs485_total_load_ul: Actual receiver/poweroff driver plus bias total; selected standard driver supports32UL.
native.rs485_driver_diff_abs_v: Actual differential output magnitude under declared fixture.
native.rs485_driver_a_v: Actual signed individual outputA under unloaded fixture.
native.rs485_driver_b_v: Actual signed individual outputB under unloaded fixture.
native.rs485_driver_offset_v: Actual signed offset -1..3V in selected loaded test, not absolute-value misreading.
native.rs485_short_test_v: Actual applied output short stress -7..12V, not normal bus differential voltage.
native.rs485_short_current_abs_ma: Actual short current<=250mA under stated stress and duration.
native.rs485_receiver_diff_v: Actual VA-VB signed differential, conventional±200mV sensitivity.
native.rs485_receiver_diff_abs_v: Actual differential magnitude, must also satisfy selected device absolute limits.
native.rs485_fixture_ohm: Actual54ohm waveform fixture only, not installed termination.
native.rs485_fixture_pf: Actual50pF waveform fixture only, not cable capacitance.
native.rs485_fall_ns: Actual loaded fall under same fixture.
native.rs485_overshoot_percent: Actual overshoot/undershoot after transition<=10percent full differential swing.
native.rs485_cable_m: Actual cable length;1200m/10Mbps examples not simultaneous guaranteed limits.
native.rs485_cable_impedance_ohm: Actual cable characteristic impedance;120ohm is source recommendation, not every installed cable.
native.rs485_termination_ohm: Actual effective per-end termination matching line characteristic impedance.
native.rs485_termination_count: Actual per-pair termination count, two cable ends in parallel/split design.
native.rs485_split_resistor_ohm: Actual each split resistor, sum pair forms effective per-end termination.
native.rs485_split_filter_pf: Actual split commonmode filter capacitor,220pF sourceexample not a standard default.
native.rs485_velocity_fraction: Actual cable propagation speed as fraction of vacuum light speed, not generic78percent.
native.rs485_stub_delay_ns: Actual one-way electrical stub delay; TIguideline<=rise/10.
native.rs485_media_pf_m: Actual distributed medium capacitance per metre.
native.rs485_node_cap_pf: Actual lumped node load including pins/connector/PCB/protection.
native.rs485_noise_abs_mv: Actual maximum differential noise for commissioned failsafe margin.
native.rs485_bias_diff_v: Actual external failsafe differential including200mV threshold+noise.
native.rs485_bias_supply_min_v: Actual minimum bias supply used for resistor calculation.
native.rs485_bias_max_ohm: Source guide maximum bias resistance Vmin*375*Z0/[VAB*(Z0+1500)], distinct selected resistor.
native.rs485_bias_selected_ohm: Actual installed bias resistor each, not universal523ohm.
native.rs485_ground_diff_v: Actual installed ground potential difference and noise incorporated into receivercommonmode.
native.rs485_word_data_bits: Actual higher codec data width; no mandatory UART8N1.
native.rs485_word_wire_bits: Actual serialized positions including selected framing/encoding overhead.
native.rs485_wire_time_ms: Actual wire_bits/rate elapsed time, separate media-access wait and turnaround.
native.rs485_grant_wait_ms: Actual higher protocol/scheduler grant wait bound; RS485 supplies no arbitration protocol.
native.rs485_enable_delay_ms: Actual enabledriver setup time before firstbit.
native.rs485_turnaround_ms: Actual driver disable/line release/peer switch bound.
native.rs485_process_ms: Actual complete receiver frame verification/decode/application bound.
native.rs485_transaction_limit_ms: Actual independent application transaction acceptance requirement.
native.rs485_value_accepted: Actual complete transaction accepted by consumer.
native.rs485_de_control_verified: Actual mutually exclusive per-pair driver-enable schedule verified.
native.rs485_mapping_valid: Actual device identity/truth table/codec/value mapping valid.
native.rs485_short_indefinite_verified: Actual device passes full-voltage indefinite short stress; current alone does not prove this.
native.rs485_acceptance_source: Actual independent application functional timing acceptance.
native.rs485_polarity_source: Actual device signed differential truth table and installed wiring.
native.rs485_failsafe_source: Actual idle/open/short and noise-qualified failsafe proof.
native.rs485_wave_source: Actual correlated waveform and decoded frame observation.
native.rs485_short_source: Actual full applied stress/time/device compliance source.
native.payload_bytes: Actual application byte count under independently selected wireprotocol. RS485 electrical medium defines no universalUART8N1,Modbuspacket or65535byteapplication limit.
